title: LACTOCOCCUS CREMORIS STRAIN AND USE THEREOF FOR PREPARING FOOD PRODUCTS
abstract:
The present invention concerns the field of food products and specifically relates to new strains of Lactococcus cremoris with improved properties.
    The invention further relates to a composition comprising the Lactococcus cremoris strain, and to a food product, in particular a dairy product and plant based milk products prepared by using the strain. The invention is also extended to the application of the improved Lactococcus cremoris strains in the fermentation of vegetable and fruit matrices.

title: ENZYMATIC TREATMENT TO IMPROVE TEXTURE OF FERMENTED PLANT-BASED CHEESE-ANALOGUE
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for improving organoleptic properties of a plant-based cheese-analogue, and the resulting products as such. In particular, the combination of fermentation and enzymatic treatment yields a plant-based matrix with improved gel properties, such as increased hardness and springiness, to provide a product with a sensory feel that mimic dairy-based cheese. In addition, the treatment also reduces the number of bitterness-associated peptides found in the product.

title: VEGAN CHEESE COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF MAKING THE SAME
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to non-animal proteins and their use in various comestible products, particularly cheese analogue products. In some embodiments, the disclosure provides an ingestible composition comprising pea protein, soy protein, or a combination thereof, along with a minor amount of an additional protein, such fava bean protein, mung bean protein, lentil protein, sunflower protein, canola protein, potato protein, rice protein, or combinations thereof. In some embodiments, the ingestible compositions also comprise certain fibers, which allows the blend to be suitable for addition to an ingestible composition useful for making products having the consistency of cheese. In some embodiments, flavorings or flavor-modifiers are combined with the non-animal proteins as well. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides methods of making such vegan cheese products, for example, by extrusion, molding, and the like.

title: Legume protein concentrates
abstract: A legume protein concentrate having a protein content of about 40-70%, preferably 50-60%. The concentrate exhibits trypsin inhibitor activity (TIA) at up to about 2mg/g and has a water binding capacity of at least about 2.0g/g. Preferably, the protein concentrate is obtained from fava beans, peas, lentils, or chickpeas. Preferably, the protein concentrate is not chemically or enzymatically modified. Preferably, the protein concentrate has a reduced off-flavour and low amounts of antinutritional factors. Preferably, the protein concentrate comprises <7mg/kg vicine and/or <5mg/kg convicine. The concentrate also has a high water-binding capacity and is preferably useful in a variety of food and drink products. An extrusion process for producing the legume protein concentrate is also provided where the material does not exceed ~115°C during extrusion and preferably includes the addition of water in an amount of from 0.05 to 0.2 L/kg.

title: Inhibitors of cell envelope proteases from lactic acid bacteria
abstract: The present disclosure is a screening procedure that allows identification of inhibitors of Cellular Envelope Proteases (CEPs) in pathogenic bacteria by using Lactic Acid Bacteria (LAB). The screening platform can be used to screen libraries of compounds to generate a high throughput evaluation of drug candidates, and as exemplified below, a single screening result of 6808 compounds identified 20 compounds that inhibited CEP of lactococcus lactis (Lactococcus lactis).

title: STREPTOCOCCUS THERMOPHILUS STRAINS WITH IMPROVED TEXTURING PROPERTIES
abstract: The invention provides Streptococcus thermophilus mutants, such as DSM22933, which have improved texturizing properties. The strains have: (i) a mutation in the branched chain amino acid transport ATP-binding protein LivG (TC 3.A.1.4.1) gene; (ii) a mutation in the ABC transporter permease protein gene; and/or (iii) a mutation in the peptide deformylase protein gene. The invention, furthermore, relates to compositions, such as a starter culture, comprising one or more of these mutants, to fermented products made using these mutants and to the use of the mutants and compositions of the invention.

title: TEXTURED VEGETABLE PROTEIN
abstract:
The invention provides a low-moisture extruded texturized vegetable protein, defined as a fibrous and firm protein material obtained by extrusion at a moisture content of 20-30 wt. %, said texturized vegetable protein having a protein content of at least 70 wt. % relative to dry matter, which texturized vegetable protein is prepared by extrusion of a feed composition comprising
a) a source of plant protein from seed, cereal, algae, fruit, leaf or legume comprising at least 65 wt. % plant protein, relative to dry matter; andb) a source of tuber protein, comprising at least 75 wt. % tuber protein, relative to dry matter.

    The invention furthermore provides food products comprising the TVP of the invention, as well as methods for obtaining these products, and use thereof for substituting animal-derived meat in food products.

title: SHRIMP MOULDING APPARATUS
abstract: A food molding apparatus is provided. The apparatus comprises at least one mold with at least one cavity for receiving the food to be molded, an injector with at least one nozzle or a set of nozzles. Each cavity includes an inlet configured to receive the food from the injector and an outlet configured to allow the escape of gas. The apparatus also includes a closure that selectively closes the inlet.

title: LOW SUGAR OAT BASE OR OAT DRINK
abstract: The invention relates to a liquid oat base or oat drink comprising an oat derived material with 5-25% by weight dry substance, based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat drink, wherein the oat derived material comprises, by dry weight of the oat derived material, DP1 to DP2 sugars present in an amount of 7% or below, and DP3 to DP8 oligosaccharides present in an amount of 5-40%. The invention further relates to a method for production of a liquid oat base or oat drink.

title: Coacervate core-shell microcapsules
abstract: Described herein are plant-based coacervate core-shell microcapsules, where the shell includes a plant protein extract, as well as methods and uses of the same.

title: LIPID-BASED MICROCAPSULES
abstract: The present invention relates to a new process for the preparation of microcapsules. Microcapsules are also an object of the invention. Consumer products comprising said microcapsules, in particular perfumed consumer products or flavoured consumer products are also part of the invention.

title: TEXTURIZED VEGETABLE PROTEIN
abstract: The invention relates to a dry extrusion process for preparing a texturized vegetable protein comprising extruding a mixture of rapeseed protein, a legume derived protein and calcium carbonate, to a composition comprising rapeseed protein, a legume-derived protein, calcium and a plant-based fiber, to the use of said composition in the preparation of a meat alternative and to meat alternatives. It also relates to the use of calcium carbonate for improving the hydration rate, water holding capacity and/or density of a texturized vegetable protein comprising rapeseed protein.

title: A PROCESS FOR PRODUCING A PROTEIN ISOLATE FROM A GRAIN MATERIAL AND A PROTEIN ISOLATE PRODUCED THEREFROM
abstract: The present invention provides a process for producing a protein isolate from grain material which includes a step of treating the liquid protein stream with a bleaching agent to reduce the colour of the protein isolate. The present invention also provides a protein isolate and food and beverage products comprising the protein isolate.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A NATURAL COLORANT FROM COFFEE SILVER SKIN
abstract: An extraction of brown colorants from coffee silver skin is carried out using ultrasound-assisted extraction and water as an environmentally friendly solvent. Extraction efficiency is achieved by optimizing the factors of duration, temperature, amplitude and solvent-to-solid ratio. The characteristics of the final product are determined by the application of optimum conditions during the extraction of brown colorants. The product of the present invention finds applications as a natural brown colorant in food and beverage formulations, as its properties are comparable to commercial caramel color E150d.

title: TEXTURED WHEAT PROTEINS
abstract: The invention relates to a textured wheat gluten protein composition characterised in that it comprises wheat gluten proteins and sodium bicarbonate, to a method for producing same and to the use thereof.

title: Kariteno in food products
abstract: Use of karitene as an emulsifier in a dairy or dairy-analogue food product, wherein the food product comprises an emulsion comprising one or more oils and water; wherein the food product comprises karitene in an amount from 0.01% to 10% by weight of the food product; and wherein the food product comprises at least 0.5% karitene by weight of the total amount of one or more oils present in the food product.

title: METHOD OF PREPARING A CROP-BASED COMPOSITION
abstract: A method of preparing a liquid crop-based composition for use as a food includes the steps of: i) rinsing a crop having at least one antinutritive compound with an aqueous liquid for a first time period, wherein the aqueous liquid has a temperature of 50° C.-90° C.; ii) disintegrating the rinsed crop, and mixing it with an aqueous liquid to obtain a liquid crop-based composition; iii) subjecting the liquid crop-based composition to an amylase so as to at least partially degrade starch in the liquid crop-based composition; and iv) subjecting the liquid crop-based composition to a betaglucosidase under first dosage, time and temperature conditions so as to reduce the content of the at least one antinutritive compound.

title: LACTOCOCCUS BACTERIAL STRAINS FOR FERMENTATION OF PLANT-BASED PREPARATION
abstract: The present invention relates to bacterial strains belonging to the species Lactococcus lactis and further relates to their used the fermentation process when inoculated with a plant-based preparation, for the production of dairy alternative products.

title: METHOD FOR GENERATING A SOYA PROTEIN TEXTURATE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing an anisotropic plant-based soya texturate, the texturate comprising a water proportion of less than 50 wt.% and more than 50 wt.% soya-based ingredients based on the dry mass, wherein a protein proportion comprises more than 30 wt.% based on the dry mass. In the method, a soya protein mixture with more than 50% of the dry mass is provided and from this a basic mixture is generated such that a water proportion of the basic mixture is in the range from 25 wt.% to 55 wt.%. The basic mixture is extruded. Then, a first axial and/or transversal stretch is exerted on the extrudate, in particular in a channel with a changing cross section, to generate a texturate. Finally, the texturate can be rolled or cut.

title: METHOD OF MAKING FERMENTED PLANT-BASED PRODUCTS HAVING KOKUMI CHARACTERISTICS AND PRODUCTS THEREOF
abstract: The method comprises a step of providing a plant protein substrate and a step of fermenting the plant protein substrate with a starter culture comprising Lactobacillus johnsonii. It also relates to such a fermented plant-based product and to Lactobacillus johnsonii strains suitable for the invention. It also relates to peptides that impart and/or enhance kokumi, method for preparing such peptides, composition comprising such peptides and use of such peptides as flavouring agent.

title: Method for producing a preferably vegan food product particulate, preferably vegan food product particulate, and preferably vegan final food product
abstract:
A method for producing a vegan food product particulate (X, Y) based on almond flour, as a recipe component or directly as a final food product, includes:
a) providing partially de-oiled almond flour having between 5 and 20% by weight fat and between 43 and 57% by weight protein,b) providing water,c) producing a liquid mixture of the partially de-oiled almond flour and the water, the percentage by weight of the almond flour being between 1 and 40% by weight and of water being between 60 and 99% by weight,d) heating the liquid mixture to a temperature between 72° C. and 138° C. and obtaining a heated liquid,e) high-pressure homogenizing the heated liquid in a hot high-pressure homogenization step and obtaining a heated hot high-pressure homogenized liquid,f) cooling the heated hot high-pressure homogenized liquid.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A SOY PROTEIN TEXTURATE
abstract: The invention relates to a process for producing an anisotropic vegetable soy texturate, the texturate comprising a water content of less than 50% by weight and more than 50% by weight of soy-based ingredients based on the dry matter, wherein a protein content of more than 30% by weight based on the dry matter is provided. In the process, a soy protein mixture with more than 50% by dry matter is provided and a base mixture is produced therefrom, such that a water content of the base mixture is in the range of 25% by weight to 55% by weight. The base mixture is extruded. Thereafter, a first axial and/or transverse stretching is exerted on the extrudate, in particular in a channel with a changing cross-section, to produce a texturate. Finally, the texturate can be rolled or cut.

title: LACTIC BACTERIUM WITH MODIFIED GALACTOKINASE EXPRESSION FOR TEXTURIZING FOOD PRODUCTS BY OVEREXPRESSION OF EXOPOLYSACCHARIDE
abstract: The present invention relates to a bacterial cell with texturizing property, starter cultures comprising the cell, and diary products fermented with the starter culture.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A DEODORIZED DRY LEGUME PROTEIN
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a deodorized pea protein, and to a deodorized pea protein and the use thereof for producing products requiring pressurized heat treatments, for example for producing ready-to-drink beverages or extruded products. The method comprises: providing a suspension of pea protein extract, adding peroxide to said suspension in order to form an additive-containing suspension, heat-treating the additive-containing suspension, optionally followed by rapid vacuum cooling, forming a deodorized protein solution and recovering the deodorized pea protein, wherein the weight amount of peroxide added, expressed relative to the dry weight of the pea protein extract in the suspension, ranges from 100 to 2000 pp

title: Method for preparing food ingredient and formed meat analogue, increasing oil droplet size, and using starch as a stabilizer or emulsifier
abstract: Method of preparing a food ingredient, method of increasing oil droplet size in a fat mimicking analogue, food ingredient, formed meat analogue, method for manufacturing a formed meat analogue, and method of using starch as a stabilizer, Pickering emulsion particle-type emulsifier or particle-emulsifier. To improve mouthfeel of a food ingredient that is preferably a fat imitate, liquid oil droplets encapsulated within a gel matrix of starch formed with water or a water-based liquid is provided, such that the gel matrix substantially entraps the liquid oil droplets in a controllably releasable manner. The patent application contains parallel method and product claims.

title: NEW STRAINS AND BLENDS FOR TEXTURE AND FLAVOR IN PLANT-BASED CHEESE-ANALOGUES
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for improving the organoleptic experience of a plant-based cheese-analogue, and the resulting products as such. In particular, bacterial blends that through fermentation of a plant base yield a gel or matrix with improved texture and flavor that resemble that of dairy cheese. The present application also provides bacterial strains which contribute to gel firmness or improve of flavor profile in plant-based

title: Method for making fermented plant-based products that have kokumi characteristics
abstract: The method comprises a step for providing a vegetable protein substrate and a step for fermenting the vegetable protein substrate with a starter culture comprising Lactobacillus johnsonii. It also relates to such a fermented plant-based product and to Lactobacillus johnsonii strains suitable for the invention. It further relates to peptides that impart and/or enhance kokumi, a method for preparing such peptides, a composition comprising such peptides, and the use of such peptides as a flavoring agent.

title: PLANT PROTEIN PRODUCTS AND METHODS OF PRODUCING THEREOF
abstract: The present disclosure relates to plant-based protein products with improved properties, and particularly to a plant protein product, a method of producing a plant protein product, and a food product comprising the plant protein product.

title: EXTRUDER AND ROLLER APPARATUS
abstract: Extrusion is used in the production of foodstuffs. There is provided herein an apparatus for the extrusion of protein-based material, comprising: an extruder comprising an extruding slot; and a roller support adjacent the extruding slot, comprising: a plurality of rollers arranged around a tubular structure with an increasing radius along the longitudinal axis, with first radius R1 at a first end adjacent the extruding slot, and a second radius R2 at a second end, where R2 > R1.

title: COMBINATION OF PLANT PROTEINS AND OLEOGELS IN HIGH MOISTURE EXTRUSION
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for preparing a texturized plant-based food product, the process comprising the steps of a) feeding a chamber, for example an extrusion barrel, with a composition comprising plant protein, water, and an oleogel; b) conveying the composition from step a) through the chamber; and c) cooling the composition from step b).

title: Novel strains and blends for texture and flavor in plant-based cheese analogues
abstract: The present application relates to a method for improving the sensory experience of plant-based cheese analogues and the products obtained thereby. In particular, the bacterial blend produces a gel or matrix with improved texture and flavor similar to dairy cheese through fermentation of the plant base. The application also provides bacterial strains that promote hardness or improve flavor profile of plant-based gels.

title: Method for producing fibrous protein extrudates
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing a fibrous protein extrudate comprising the steps of a) providing an aqueous protein slurry, b) treating the aqueous protein slurry in an extruder, the treatment comprising the steps of-a heating step to produce a hot slurry, -a kneading step comprising transporting the hot slurry through one or more sequences of kneading barrels having barrel temperatures of 151-200 ℃, the hot slurry being kneaded in the one or more kneading barrels to produce a pre-organized protein mass, and-a pre-cooling step to produce a organized protein mass, C) feeding the organized protein mass from the extruder through a splitter plate to a cooling die to produce a structured protein mass, and d) discharging the structured protein mass from the cooling die to produce a fibrous protein extrudate. The method of the present invention is capable of producing fibrous protein extrudates with a superior texture similar to chicken.

title: Device and method for producing milk-air emulsions
abstract: A device for producing a milk-air emulsion, which has at least one steam lance (1) which has at least one outlet opening (22) and which is designed to be immersed at least with the outlet opening (22) into a vessel (2) filled with milk, wherein with the aid of a steam system (7) and with the aid of an air system (8) steam and air can be guided through the steam lance (1) and its outlet opening (22) into the milk, wherein the steam lance (1) has a device for height adjustment which is designed such that the vertical position of the steam lance, in particular the vertical position of the outlet of the steam lance, is adjustable.

title: Heat-stable plant-based protein-product
abstract: The present invention relates to a heat stable plant based protein product. Particularly, the invention relates to a heat stable plant based protein product which can be used as a meat substitute that can be heated by microwaves, fried or grilled. The present invention relates also processes for producing such heat stable plant based protein products.

title: TEXTURED LEGUME PROTEINS WITH IMPROVED FIRMNESS
abstract: The present invention relates to a specific composition comprising a particular mixture of textured field bean and pea proteins, the firmness of which is greater than that of similar products currently on the market, as well as to the production method thereof and to the use of same in food compositions, particularly meat substitutes.

title: BETA-GLUCAN-RICH CEREAL PLANT-BASED BEVERAGE
abstract: The invention relates to a cereal plant-based beverage comprising an amount of beta-glucan of at least 1.2 g/100 ml of plant-based beverage. The invention further relates to a method for preparing such a plant-based beverage.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PRODUCING AN EMULSION-BASED FAT POWDER TO MANUFACTURE A FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to an emulsion-based fat powder comprising a dispersible aqueous phase (DP) of water and a food colorant and a continuous fat phase (CP) of a fat having a melting point of from 40 to 80° C. The food colorant is in particular a pH dependent food colorant such as an anthocyanin-based colorant. The invention also relates to the use of the emulsion-based fat powder in meat analogues.

title: New strain of Carnobacterium maltaromaticum and its uses
abstract: The invention relates to a specific strain of Carnobacterium maltaromaticum, a bacterial preparation comprising at least said strain of C. maltaromaticum and their use in the preparation of a food product.

title: Method of producing a fermented plant drink based on walnut and fermented plant drink based on walnut
abstract: The subject of the application is a method for producing a fermented plant drink based on walnuts and a fermented plant drink based on walnuts. In the method for producing a fermented plant drink containing a filtered water extract produced from a suspension containing water, walnuts, dried dates and flax seeds, fermented by yogurt bacteria, the suspension is formed from a mixture of separately washed, shelled (10), crushed walnuts (11) in an amount of 83.2% to 83.9% by weight in the mixture, crushed dried dates (13) in an amount of 0.0% to 12.6% by weight in the mixture, and crushed flax seeds (12) in an amount of 3.8% to 5.0% by weight in the mixture, with a grain size after crushing of 0.05 mm to 0.1 mm and water in an amount of 74.0% to 77.0% by weight in the suspension, which is poured over the mixture, and the resulting suspension is mixed (14) and is subjected to extraction (15), with continuous stirring, at a rotational speed of 1900 to 2100 rpm at a temperature of 28°C to 32°C for 14 to 16 minutes, and the resulting extract is filtered, poured into individual packages and pasteurized in individual packages, and then cooled to a temperature of 38°C to 42°C and inoculated with a mixture of bacterial strains of Streptococcus thermopilus, Lactobacillus delbrueckii ssp. bulgaricus, Lactobacillus acidophilus and Bifidobacterium lactis. and incubated at the above temperature.

title: HEAT STABLE RAPESEED PROTEIN COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention is directed to a composition comprising rapeseed protein, a hydrocolloid, and a vegetable oil, and to the use of such composition in food products such as a beverage.
